freePlan.limits: No subscription fee, no per-seat charge, no activation cost, no minimum spend; pay only for rides taken at standard Bolt consumer fares.

plans.name: Bolt Business (free account, pay per ride)

keyLimits.en: No fixed price; costs are entirely per-ride, at the same fares as standard Bolt consumer rides, which vary by city and demand (surge pricing applies).

cautions.en: There is no fixed per-ride rate: fares vary by city and fluctuate with demand/surge pricing, so no single number can represent 'the price' of the service.

capabilities.en: Centralized ride management for teams: add employees, set spending controls, and get a single consolidated monthly invoice.
Multi-modal transport options in one platform: rides, e-scooters, e-bikes and car rentals.
Expense reporting integrations for corporate accounting workflows.

limitations.en: No fixed subscription pricing means costs are unpredictable and depend entirely on ride volume and local surge pricing.
Service availability and fare competitiveness depend on the city; Bolt does not operate everywhere Uber does.

unknowns: No currentAlternatives or clear same-category catalogue matches were found among the seed's alternativeCandidates (mostly unrelated finance/payment tools), so alternatives list is left empty.
Exact enterprise-tier features (if any beyond the free self-serve account) not confirmed; the source describes only the free, pay-per-ride model.
